scope: Eleven recorded boards from four live Deity Russia Religious-target games (2026-11-09 and 11-10), each at the first state frame of a turn where a religious unit of ours stood at 60 hit points or less at least three tiles from any city of ours. Each board was replayed twice through one frozen `civvis_orders --resumed` built from this branch, with the run's own forced genome; the on arm adds `--with corps-comes-home-alive`. Orders changed on 10 of 11 boards and the wounded unit's own orders on 5: it turns for our nearest Lavra instead of walking on. On the other boards an earlier evasion rule had already moved the unit the same way in both arms.
